Ice and gear accidents jointly confound missingness, so this cannot separately attribute coverage loss to ice alone. Lack of area-wide krill estimate is missing, NOT zero. Observatory installation is not a dataset of observed nest numbers or breeding success. No 2026 krill density, nor causal or future abundance/vegetation effect.

In 300-source TDR quality census, provisional q1 60min zero-baseline range >2dbar in 42/300, five extreme >100dbar, PI009 repeated same-second source timestamps 668268; true pressure-to-depth, surface ZOC and dive capture remain unvalidated.

PI009 has 614298 same-timestamp pressure values differing from first among 668268 additional records; potential logger time precision mismatch; five source tags have hourly q1 span >100dbar. Source metadata and validated calibration needed before accurate dive-time location.

Original 25km monthly OSI satellite SIC can be matched to original 2011/13/15/18 Chinstrap GPS months, but lacks daily/microscale sea-ice navigability, independent prey biomass and stage-specific breeding response; do not use monthly 15% SIC as literal penguin travel barrier.

Daily OSI-450-a1 SI-Powell 2013/14 source same-calendar-day 14-day SIC and fixed native satellite pixel ice-reduction are robust DESCRIPTIVE physical environmental observations, but one posthoc breeding season, no true bird-specific ice traversability or biological outcome validation; do not infer ice causal mechanism or transfer to 2050/2100 demographics.

Large same-day Signy−other-island DAILY SIC contrast seen in the selected 2013/14 Powell case is NOT a general three-pair rule: 2011 Laurie all fixed ocean-cell shared-day difference 0pp and 2015 Monroe December +0.52pp/January 0pp; the 2013 winter/early-summer event is one post-hoc case, no ice-passability or independent krill-to-breeding mechanism.

Across original 45 daily OSI GPS-shared dates (2011/12,2013/14,2015/16), the strong 2013 Signy-Powell ice SIC contrast does not recur in other matched island-year pairs; same species but other-island identity confounded with year; 2011 December only one shared day. Do not generalize ice barrier or ice-to-krill explanation, prey capture or future breeding response.

Same-day same-distance original satellite SIC contrasts show no universal negative GPS ice preference: in 2013 December Signy tracks have +6.027pp excess vs same-distance ocean while Powell tracks have −6.202pp; this is not a causal ice avoidance/attraction or true passability test. 2011/15 original paired ice mostly zero; no environmental signal to test.

Original daily OSI SAF 25km observed-ice binary graph falsification: 0 source GPS low-SIC pixels disconnected from a hypothetical coastal open component across all 4320 island-day/threshold/sensitivity rows. The only <=15% low-ice connectivity discrepancy is 39 native GPS satellite pixel-days >=15% SIC, entirely in 2013; no visited pixel >=30%. Consequently no extra graph-severance signal for true penguin movement or ice barrier is supported on this source grain, and thresholds 15/30/50% are not validated passability cutoffs.

2026-07 Rusch et al. (ICES JMS, DOI 10.1093/icesjms/fsag115) already reported prey accessibility rather than maximum acoustic biomass as a chinstrap foraging determinant using 2022 Monroe & 2023 Powell high-frequency GPS/TDR plus acoustic surveys (45 penguins). Broad 'prey access over absolute density' is NOT a new mina claim. Underlying 2026 paper data are held by IMR/NPI and require reasonable request/collaboration; 2024 Schoombie et al. (DOI 10.1098/rsos.240271) published accelerometer+video prey capture validation for Monroe2022/Powell2023 (41 individuals), public code/example data only. Separate new macro question is when independently measured offshore prey opportunity and terrestrial breeding-site opportunity jointly predict nesting-space contraction/recovery across species, island-years and heldout geography.

No validated krill→penguin breeding causal inference from IMR annual 2023-2025 overall-stratum acoustic summaries alone: published annual means/CV outside 2011–20 GAM training, but 25km source GPS and regional acoustic transects not spatially/temporally matched, model lacks 2023–25 predictions, 2025 CV0.75 and 2021–22 missing. Descriptive 13-year Kendall tau~0.039 p~0.855 does not prove no climate response.

2026 South Orkney pack-ice + trawl propeller accident jointly prevented representative survey coverage; IMR2026 expressly reports NO full-area acoustic krill density/biomass. The observation process is environmentally and operationally censored, not krill=0, and ice alone cannot be assigned the whole cause. 2026 Chinstrap Coronation Island observatory is installed but reports NO longitudinal breeding outcomes.

The earlier IMR2024-reprint-derived 13-year (2011-2020 10 values + 2023-25 3) annual krill Kendall tau +.038710, p=.8545 is scientifically INVALID due source-year shift; original Skaret2023 Combined 2013 missing and 2020 different. Only current 12-year source-authority-corrected values may be used.

Original 2011-2026 publisher acoustic observation-process audit: of 14 source-documented survey years, 2013 and 2026 have no whole-area biomass estimate, both with explicit ice coverage restriction (2026 also ship accident), while 2015 had reduced southern coverage but produced Combined. 2021/22 remain unaudited rather than zero or proof surveys absent. This non-random survey availability cannot be ignored in ice/krill regressions or interpreted as a penguin ice barrier.
rule: Only add verified positive entries with source+sampling grain+effect+limitations+workflow where present. Never convert observational association into causal mechanistic support. Never merge draft PR189/199 to main without author signoff.
